title: Kayak Cruises Scraper
description: Browse Kayak cruise sailings with ship, departure port, trip length, itinerary, fare, currency, and region. Batch ocean or river product types and sort offers.

sailing_types.title: Cruise types
sailing_types.description: KAYAK cruise product types to retrieve, such as ocean or river sailings.

product_type.title: Product Type
product_type.description: Cruise product category, such as ocean or river. Accepted values: ocean, river.

min_nights.title: Min Nights
min_nights.description: Minimum number of nights for returned cruise sailings.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult travelers included in the search.

children.title: Children
children.description: Number of children traveling on the cruise search.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Sort order for returned search results. Accepted values: recommended, price, duration, departuredate.

sort_order.title: Sort Order
sort_order.description: Direction used for the selected result sort. Accepted values: asc, desc.

include_deals.title: Include Deals
include_deals.description: Whether to include offers marked as cruise deals.

include_unavailable.title: Include Unavailable
include_unavailable.description: Whether to include sailings marked unavailable.
